sources.note: Rounding to closest BR step, ties upward; single/two aircraft formulas follow current Wiki.
Maximum 11 crew slots; also confirmed by Ninth Wave changelog 2026-03-18.

notes: BR is stored as integer one-third steps above 1.0. Use exact steps, not rounded one-decimal labels.
Ground RB aircraft use trb, Ground SB aircraft use tsb; ground AB ignores crew aircraft.
Ground RB includes helicopters using their RB rating. Ground AB, fixed-wing Air and Naval lineups exclude helicopters. Helicopter-only PVE/event matchmaking is not estimated as a mixed Ground lineup.
Naval aircraft use their AB/RB rating; aircraft above one step over the highest vessel are excluded.
SB ground uses event vehicle lists; air SB uses room Required/Allowed BR ranges. No synthetic queue SB matchmaking BR.
Sharing stores country and ordered vehicles only; name, battle type and Air RB selected aircraft are local settings. Import infers type and selects the first eligible aircraft.
